trim.label: advanced
trim.description: Whether to trim the source code to remove leading and trailing whitespaces and line breaks.

resolveResource.label: advanced
resolveResource.description: Whether a result of the expression that is a String starting with resource: is loaded as a resource and its content becomes the result, e.g. a script that returns resource:templates/order.json. The name has no scheme and is loaded from the classpath: camel run puts the files given on the command line on the classpath and export puts them in src/main/resources, so the same name works in both. A name with a scheme (file:, http: ...) or with .. fails. Let the route choose the name, such as a fixed folder with a name picked by the route, and do not take it straight from the message. Off by default; the resource: prefix on the expression text itself is always resolved. Applies to the expression used as a value, not as a predicate.
